parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 6 dropped val_bpb from 1.093478 to 1.060918. Increasing model capacity is clearly yielding high returns. I'll now focus on refining the learning rate and weight decay to maximize the potential of this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increased DEPTH to 6 to boost capacity, increased MATRIX_LR to 0.15 to accelerate learning, and introduced a small WEIGHT_DECAY to improve generalization.
